about_the_game:
This DLC unlocks an extra Japan-themed level, where even more mischievous cats are waiting to be found and colored. Explore the scene, spot every kitty, and bring it to life with color-by-number!

THIS DLC INCLUDES:

1 extra level

100 new hidden cats

Full color-by-number mode for the new scene
